title: Hopeverse: Villain Wedding Theme v3 (stylish, a hook every 8-12 s)
maker: ElevenLabs Music API on the owner's paid plan

positive_global_styles: a stylish, suave, swaggering villain's theme at his own grand South Indian wedding: cool, confident, groovy and celebratory, composed like a senior blockbuster film composer
slow-motion strut groove, about 90 BPM half-time, heavy and groovy
a catchy whistled 5-note signature hook that becomes the main melody, in a minor scale with Carnatic gamakam slides

balanced fusion: a real festive wedding band (nadaswaram, thavil, brass band) and real veena, mridangam and strings share the spotlight equally with fresh slick electronics (fat synth bass, crisp electronic drums, finger snaps)
a twangy veena riff played like a cool surf guitar, and a slick melodic bass line moving like a second melody

positive_local_styles: the first sound: a metal lighter flick and a cool deep hit
then only two sounds: slow finger snaps and the villain's cool whistled 5-note hook
transition: a slick melodic bass walks in and answers the whistled hook phrase by phrase
transition: thavil enters, then the wedding nadaswaram plays the hook, brass swells, all locked to the villain's groove
ends with one full beat of silence
transition: a massive slam into the slow-motion strut, the hook on twangy veena like a surf guitar over a heavy half-time groove, finger snaps and fat synth bass
transition: the hook becomes a grand, joyous wedding melody on nadaswaram and brass band, festive thavil, strings counter-melody
transition: the veena and the nadaswaram trade the hook back and forth, each answer shorter and faster, over the strut
transition: the ketti melam, a frenzied wedding drum roll on thavil, crashes in and the hook returns a half step higher, biggest and most stylish
the whistled hook one last time, a lighter flick, one final cool hit, then stop

brief.notes: Jithesh 29 Oct 10:17: every 8-12 s a transition with a proper hook (rule 9.11 tightened). v3 = v2's stylish swagger wedding, re-cut into 8-12 s sections, each landing on the hook; no break longer than 4 s (v2 had an 8 s lull).

story: A stylish, suave villain makes his slow-motion entry at his own grand wedding.
human_work: to be added by the owner: melody, take choice, edits, mix
